headline: US backs Musk in fight over EU tech fine
summary: The Trump administration's Justice Department is backing Elon Musk in his fight against a €120 million EU fine on X, imposed under the Digital Services Act. Washington argues Brussels overreached in pursuing X's owner and his wider corporate empire.
